# `mapMapErrorToMapBoth`

Suggests Effect.mapBoth when Effect.map and Effect.mapError are adjacent steps of a piping flow

| Property | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Category | Style |
| Default severity | `suggestion` |
| Fixable | Yes |
| Effect versions | v3, v4 |
| Diagnostic codes | `TS377153` |
| Language Service name | `mapMapErrorToMapBoth` |
| Oxlint name | `effecttsgo/map-map-error-to-map-both` |

## Preview

```ts
import { Data, Effect } from "effect"

class TaskError extends Data.TaggedError("TaskError")<{
  readonly message: string
}> {}

declare const fetchCount: Effect.Effect<number, string>

// MUST TRIGGER: adjacent Effect.map + Effect.mapError is a single Effect.mapBoth
export const isPositive = fetchCount.pipe(
  Effect.map((n) => n > 0),
  Effect.mapError((message) => new TaskError({ message }))
/**
  ^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^ effecttsgo(map-map-error-to-map-both): `Effect.map` + `Effect.mapError` transform the success and failure channels one step at a time; `Effect.mapBoth` expresses both transformations in a single step.
*/
)
```
